title: Fix keep-coding stopping when one ready bead is partial
description: keep-coding stops when the selected ready bead returns partial, even if other ready beads exist. Add robust handling so partial beads are deferred/skipped for the current run or selection avoids previously failed bead IDs, and preserve per-iteration history for final report.
close_reason: Fixed keep-coding so partial/blocked/failed beads are skipped for the current run instead of stopping the entire loop. Added deterministic cycle-note logic, per-run skip file handling, bead-coding exclude support, and regression tests.

title: Fix requirement-grooming beads workspace handling
description: requirement-grooming reports completed when create_mode=create cannot access a beads workspace, and follow-up chat can later mutate state outside the recorded run. Add workspace preflight/init guidance or automatic init and make final reporting reflect create failures accurately.
close_reason: Fixed requirement-grooming by adding an ensure-beads-workspace step that auto-initializes bd for create mode and makes reports reflect creation failures accurately.

title: Allow bead-coding to close already-completed beads without new commit
description: keep-coding stops after one loop when bead-coding finds no new changes for an already-completed bead. Adjust bead-coding close semantics so final-check ready_to_close can close validated beads even when commit is skipped/no changes, while still preventing repeated loops.
close_reason: Fixed bead-coding and formula condition semantics: close-bead no longer requires a new commit when final-check allows closure, keep-coding continues after no-change closures, and condition evaluator now supports &&/||.

title: Fix keep-coding loop repetition and raise default cycles
description: keep-coding repeats the same ready bead when bead-coding returns partial/no commit/no close. Fix formula logic to stop or skip safely, improve summary, and raise default max_cycles to 100.
close_reason: Fixed keep-coding loop continuation semantics: partial/blocked/no-close cycles now stop via cycle-note.selected=false, default max_cycles raised to 100, and regression tests added.

title: 收敛多 formula 运行能力的 MVP 方向与阶段边界
description:
背景

范围
- 汇总前置 research beads 的结论
- 形成阶段目标与非目标
- 识别后续可能进入实现的最小切片

验收标准
- 明确推荐的 MVP 方向，例如偏“多个独立 run 的聚合监视”还是偏“父子编排”等
- 写清 MVP 的进入条件、最小用户价值、关键前提与不做事项
- 说明该 MVP 对 run store/dashboard/runtime 的影响范围是研究结论，不要求实现设计细节
- 输出能直接作为后续 implementation beads 的上游依据

相关模块
- 前置 beads 相关文件集合
- README.md
- internal/formula/run/store.go
- web/apps/formula/src

风险/未知项
- 如果没有单独的收口 bead，前置研究会停留在“知道很多事实”但没有决策
- MVP 需要显式缩范围，否则容易重新滑回“任意多 formula 并发平台”

范围外
- 开始实现 MVP
- 产出详细技术设计文档
- 承诺完整 roadmap
close_reason: 已完成 tt-4ce 范围内的 MVP 收口文档：基于已关闭的上游 research beads（tt-f08、tt-iqj、tt-d9e、tt-q3o、tt-ueo、tt-0gu），新增 `docs/formula/mvp-direction-and-phase-boundaries-for-multi-run.md`，明确第一阶段推荐方向为“多个独立 run 的批量发起 + 聚合监视 + 单 run drill-down”，写清进入条件、最小用户价值、关键前提、明确不做事项，以及对 run store/dashboard/runtime 的研究级影响范围和后续最小实现切片；同时在 `README.md` 增加该决策文档入口，便于后续 implementation/validation beads 直接引用。

title: 形成多 formula 运行能力的 MVP 决策记录与实现切分草案

title: 建立 step 类型在顶层多 formula 并发下的安全矩阵
description:

title: 梳理 run store 日志 取消与恢复模型对多公式批次的适配缺口
description:
背景
- 现有 run store、logs、snapshot、resume、waiting_input 与 stop request 都是单 run 中心。若要支持多个 formula 的统一监视和管理，需要先识别模型缺口。

范围
- run metadata 与目录布局
- logs/events/snapshot 的聚合假设
- stop/resume/waiting_input 在多 run 视角下的行为问题
- dashboard 后端 API 的数据模型缺口

验收标准
- 清楚描述当前 run store/metadata/logs/state/snapshot 对单 run 的假设
- 列出多 formula 聚合监视下最关键的模型缺口，例如分组、统一取消、跨 run 状态汇总、恢复入口
- 比较几种可能聚合模型（如 batch id、parent-child、supervisor）对现有代码的侵入面
- 产出一份面向后续设计的缺口清单，而非泛泛愿望列表

- internal/formula/run/store.go

依赖
- 应建立在产品形态初步收敛之后；建议参考运行模型基线

范围外
